title: Catalog entry snapshots and pricing migration UI — quickstart & release visuals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a set of UI assets and annotated screenshots for the upcoming catalog release that introduces two new models and the deprecation flow for an older model tier. Deliverables cover: quickstart onboarding screenshots, pricing migration callouts, catalog entry variants (card/list/expanded), and a one-slide changelog visual for release notes.
screenshots_needed: Catalog card — new model A (default, hover, selected)
Catalog card — new model B (default, selected, deprecated flag)
Catalog list view — bulk pricing banner visible (desktop & mobile)
Expanded model detail — compute/latency ribbon + pricing tiers
Deprecation modal — migration steps and timeline
Quickstart overlay — pick model + sample prompt (2 variations: beginner, advanced)
Release note hero slide — one-image summary for marketing and docs
Dark mode variants for all of the above
Accessibility annotations: contrast checks and focus order screenshots
acceptance_criteria: All required screenshots exported at 2x and 3x PNG and SVG where appropriate
Dark mode versions and mobile breakpoints included (320, 375, 768, 1024 widths)
Annotated Figma file with named components and spacing tokens
Release hero slide approved by PM and marketing
Deprecation modal copy reviewed and matches legal-approved timeline
Handoff checklist completed and accessible links in ticket
ux_notes: Prioritize visibility of pricing differences between model variants; use a compact ribbon for latency/compute info
Deprecation state should be visually distinct but not disruptive — use a muted orange badge and a subtle card overlay
Quickstart overlay must default to 'recommended' model for new users and include a clear CTA to 'Try sample'
Include inline microcopy explaining billing change when migrating from legacy tier
Design assets must avoid token names unique to prototype; use canonical tokens from design system
review_feedback: PM (Anika Patel, 2026-03-11): tighten migration CTA copy — replace 'Migrate now' with 'Schedule migration' for enterprise accounts
Engineering (Ravi Singh, 2026-03-11): ensure pricing badge integrates with runtime-1.18 feature flag; request exported JSON spec for badge sizes
Accessibility (Noor Haddad, 2026-03-12): color contrast on muted orange badge fails AA on 14px; increase contrast or use border
Marketing (Lena Ortiz, 2026-03-12): hero slide needs a version that fits 1200x628 for social promotions
